SELECT
  LEFT(p.product_id, 10) AS product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '') AS product_name,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_sales,
  COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS total_units_sold
FROM
  order_items oi
JOIN
  products p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
  LEFT(p.product_id, 10),
  COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '')
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
